task.description: REVIEWER hard gate (WF-02 Step 2d) on REQ-165's implementation, commit 96292e1 (SECURITY-REVIEWER already PASSed at commit 98e3eb3). Gate on idiomatic OTP usage, supervision integrity, scope creep, and decision-record consistency. Read the approved design (lib/letflow/design/req165-wasmex-process-boundary.md), the real diff (git show 96292e1), and the current full state of the touched files before verdict. mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix format --check-formatted both independently re-run by REVIEWER.
